name: A shelter for love
source:
After her adventure in Fontaine, the Traveler returns to Sumeru with a special commission from Nahida. On the day of her return, she runs into a familiar face; after chatting, she decides to ask him for a favor regarding the assignment. What kind of project do the two of them have in store?

[Translated from [url=https://caketria.itch.io/a-shelter-for-love]Itch.io[/url]]
